turns.text: I can already tell this is going to be a much better experience than my last job.
turns.zh: 我已经能感觉到，这会比我上一份工作的体验好得多。

turns.text: That was such a natural conversation.
turns.zh: 那真是一次很自然的对话。

turns.text: There are so many great examples of intermediate level English skills happening there.
turns.zh: 那里有很多中级英语水平的好例子。

turns.text: Let's break down some of the key elements that made this conversation work so well.
turns.zh: 我们来拆解一下让这段对话如此成功的一些关键要素。
